web.title: Change Vehicle State - Eclipse SUMO - Simulation of Urban MObility
web.description:
# Command 0xc4: Change Vehicle State [#](https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/TraCI/Change_Vehicle_State.html#command_0xc4_change_vehicle_state)
| Variable | ValueType | Description | [Python Method](https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/TraCI/Interfacing_TraCI_from_Python.html) |
|-|-|-|-|
| replaceStop (0x17) | compound (edgeID, vehID, nextStopIndex, edgeID, pos, laneIndex, duration, flags, startPos, until, teleport) (see below) | Replaces stop at the given index with a new stop. Automatically modifies the route if the replacement stop is at another location. [See below for additional details](https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/TraCI/Change_Vehicle_State.html#replacestop_0x17) | [replaceStop](https://sumo.dlr.de/pydoc/traci/_vehicle.html#VehicleDomain.replaceStop) |

# compound message details [#](https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/TraCI/Change_Vehicle_State.html#compound_message_details)
### replaceStop (0x17) [#](https://sumo.dlr.de/docs/TraCI/Change_Vehicle_State.html#replacestop_0x17)
Automatically modifies the route if the replacement stop is at another location
